method.target_mask: border-background model: k-means on border+sky colours, largest component farther than 98th percentile of the background spread; 1/4 resolution. Hand-drawn normalised box replaces the auto mask where it is wrong.
method.albedo: median linear target / (k * median linear sky); k=4.0 clear, 2.0 hazy, 1.2 overcast, 1.6 scene-background fallback
method.texture_hf_ratio: sum PSD(f>=0.25 cyc/px) / sum PSD(0.02..0.5 cyc/px), Hann-windowed, DC removed
method.target_lap_var: 4-neighbour Laplacian variance in DN^2 inside the target
method.sky_mean_std: sRGB luma mean/std (0..255) inside the sky/background mask
method.psd_slope: log-log slope of the radial PSD of the sky patch, 0.02..0.42 cyc/px
method.cam_noise_dn: robust sigma of the local 4-neighbour Laplacian residual in the sky patch, /sqrt(1.25), in DN

uncertainty: albedo +-35%; texture metrics are JPEG-limited (JPEG removes high-frequency energy, so hf_ratio is a lower bound); cam_noise excludes JPEG quantisation

usage_guidance.A_material: 近距大目标（mask_area_frac >= 5% 画面）：涂装颜色、蒙皮纹理、天空/背景统计只应从这里取；本图库主体属于这一类。
usage_guidance.B_degradation: 远距小目标（mask_area_frac <= 1.5%）：只能用于目标像素占比、PSF/噪声/大气退化的定性对照，不能用来定色。
usage_guidance.rule: 两类不要混用：在色/纹理上对标的样本，不能同时用来对齐退化链。
usage_guidance.not_in_gallery: 本图库不含 AOT / Anti-UAV410 那类远距退化数据（AOT 还是灰度）；20 km 机载工况没有可直接对标的真实测试集。
usage_guidance.source_corrections: VisDrone 10 类里没有飞机；MSTAR/SenSiAC 是地面车辆 SAR/IR；公开真实 SAR 飞机切片仅约 4k（SAR-AIRcraft-1.0 / SARDet-100K）。本图库只承担光学外观参考，不承担 SAR/IR 对标。
